answer:
Plutonium (not "Plotonium") was discovered at the **University of California, Berkeley**.

This element was first produced and isolated on December 14, 1940, by Glenn Seaborg and his team at UC Berkeley.

The University of California, Berkeley was officially founded on **March 23, 1868**.
